prompt: Use the attached locked V9 Companion sheet as the only visual reference. Generate exactly one clean 3 rows by 4 columns source panel with twelve equally spaced V9-matched emotion anchors in this exact reading order: row one calm content, curious question, alert surprise, joyful spark; row two affectionate warm, playful bright, anticipatory notice, puzzled processing; row three recording focus, listening focus, menu thinking, peaceful sleep. This is one persistent character identity with twelve genuinely different emotional expressions, not twelve neutral copies and not a Daily gaze strip. It is static source art for future source-component entry-hold-settle choreography, never an animation flipbook, a replacement V9 sheet, or a runtime asset. Pure white background; black and white only; no text, labels, panel lines, border or device frame. HARD EYE IDENTITY INVARIANT FOR EVERY OPEN-EYE CELL: exactly two matched upright solid filled black vertical oval eye bodies on one horizontal baseline at locked-V9 compact scale. Each eye has only one compact upper primary white reflection and one much smaller static white diamond sparkle, both fully enclosed by a thick black rim; no white cap, lower-half cutout, sclera, ring, outline, pupil, lash, changed eye shape or enlarged eye. Make every emotion distinct primarily through paired brows, petite nose/mouth, cheek dots and one detached charm only: calm content has a peaceful tiny w mouth with no extra charm; curious has a question and inquiring brows; alert has a small exclamation and O mouth; joy has a spark and delighted mouth; affection has a small heart and warm cheeks; playful has an open bright happy mouth and lively paired brows without changing eyes; anticipation has lifted paired brows and a tiny eager parted mouth with one restrained detached glint; puzzled processing has gently knitted paired brows and a small uncertain mouth with no question mark or ellipsis; recording has a record dot and focused brows; listening has detached sound arcs; menu thinking has ellipsis; sleep alone uses closed curved eyes and a tiny resting mouth. The sleep cell has no detached upper mark whatsoever: no moon, crescent, Z, spark, heart, dot, question or ellipsis. Each state must read as a distinct, adorable V9 expression at 100px thumbnail while all open eyes remain exactly the same V9 eye type. No Daily direction row, no cat outline, ears, whiskers, human styling, smirk, flirtation, romance, sadness, aggression, grey, gradient, shading, texture, charging face or error face.
